title: DeepSeek Web API: Using OpenAI SDKs with DeepSeek Models
excerpt: The DeepSeek Web API project enables developers to interact with DeepSeek's large language models using standard OpenAI API libraries. By leveraging browser automation, it creates a local proxy that translates API requests into web interface interactions, offering a creative workaround for accessing language models without native API support.
description: Use OpenAI SDKs to interact with DeepSeek models via a self-hosted browser automation proxy. DeepSeek Web API translates requests to DeepSeek's web interface.
